description: Write. Adds a custom link domain (a subdomain you own, e.g. links.hilltop.example) and returns the DNS records to add at your DNS provider: a CNAME to Strait, a TXT record proving ownership and a TXT record for the HTTPS certificate. Scale and Enterprise only, at most 5 per workspace. Needs confirm: true; without it nothing changes and you get a preview (plan, limit, domains already added).

confirm.description: true to add it; omit or false to preview

hostname.description: A subdomain you own, such as links.hilltop.example

name: add_domain
title: Add a custom domain
